description_en: Queries the list of resources onboarded to WAF in cloud native mode
description_zh: 查询云产品接入资源列表
name: DescribeCloudResourceList

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to view the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The UID of the user for resource ownership
parameters.name: owner_user_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the resource
parameters.name: resource_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The port of the cloud service onboarded to WAF
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en:
The cloud service to which the resource belongs. Valid values:

alb: ALB.

mse: MSE.

fc: FC.

sae: SAE.

ecs: ECS.
clb4: CLB (TCP).
clb7: CLB (HTTP/HTTPS).
apig: APIG.
nlb: NLB.
ddos: Anti-DDoS.

Each service supports different regions. If the service filter field has a value, you must refer to the regions supported by the service. Otherwise, the filtering may fail
parameters.help_zh:
资源所属云产品，取值：

alb：表示ALB产品。

mse：表示MSE产品。

fc：表示FC产品。

sae：表示SAE产品。

ecs：表示ECS产品。
clb4：表示CLB(TCP)产品。
clb7：表示CLB(HTTP/HTTPS)产品。
apig：表示APIG产品。
nlb：表示NLB产品。
ddos：表示DDoS产品。

每个产品支持的地域不同，产品筛选字段有值时，需要参考地域支持的产品，否则可能导致筛选失败
parameters.name: resource_product

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the onboarded resource, which is automatically generated by WAF when the resource is onboarded in cloud native mode.

You can view the resource ID in the response after you call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2839876.html to onboard the resource
parameters.help_zh:
已接入的资源ID，云产品接入时由WAF自动生成。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2839876.html接入资源后，查看响应中的资源ID
parameters.name: cloud_resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token for the next page. If a next page exists, this field returns a value.
If this parameter returns a value, it indicates that a next page exists. You can use the returned NextToken as a request parameter to obtain the data of the next page until no value is returned, which indicates that all data is retrieved
parameters.help_zh:
下一页查询凭证（Token），如果有下一页，则该字段有返回值。
该参数只要返回值，则说明还有下一页。您可以将返回的NextToken作为请求参数再次获得下一页的数据，直到无返回值，表示获取到了所有的数据
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页个数。取值范围为：1-100，默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region of the WAF instance. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name onboarded to WAF.
This parameter is supported only when the cloud service type is ddos
parameters.help_zh:
接入 WAF 的域名。
仅当云产品类型为ddos时，支持查询
parameters.name: resource_domain
